Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 1644 North Winchester Avenue, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 4,356 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicants are proposing to rehabilitate and construct a three-story
addition on the south side, a third-floor dormer addition to the north side, a
one-story rear addition/passageway to the existing three-story single family
home and replace the existing detached garage at the rear with a new two-
story attached garage with one (1) dwelling unit (ADU) on the second floor.
The proposed additions to the single family home will add approximately
753.5 sq. ft. of floor area and the home will measure 29 ft.-4.25 in. in height.
The new two-story garage will measure 21 ft.-3.5 in. tall and the proposed
ADU on the second floor will contain 709 sq. ft. of floor area. Pursuant to
Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and
pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1101-B and 17-13-1003-KK of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicants are seeking to permit the establishment of a
coach house, permit an enclosed passageway connecting the garage to the
single family home, reduce the front setback from the required 14.2 ft. to
12.38 ft., reduce the combined side setback from 7.2 ft. to 4.05 ft. (north
side setback at 0.4 ft. and the south side setback at 3.65 ft.), reduce the rear
setback from the required 33.88 ft. to 22 ft.-4 in., reduce the setback from
the rear property line located at 4.25 ft. from the centerline of the alley from
2:ft. to zero, and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by
the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,991 square feet (1.15 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 4,356 square feet per D.U.
